title: Polish Skillet Omelette
description: A hearty and flavorful omelette made with polish sausage, egg, and topped with nutty cheese.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced polish sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Push the sausage to one side of the skillet.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the sausage.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top.
Add the diced onion on top of the cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
